english.note: Use this casual insult for the unpleasant or contemptible-person side of “ingrate,” especially in an outburst.
Use this for a nasty or badly behaved person, including someone described as a little terror.
Use 衰人 when someone is called “a bad sort.”

examples.english: You ingrate, I helped you and you still complained about everything!
examples.jyutping: seoi1 jan4 bong1 nei5 zung6 jim4 saam1 jim4 sei3

examples.english: You’re such a horror, always playing tricks on people.
examples.traditional: 你真係個衰人，成日整蠱人。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 go3 seoi1 jan4 seng4 jat6 zing2 gu2 jan4

examples.english: You’re such a bad sort—you ate all my crisps!
examples.traditional: 你真係衰人，食晒我啲薯片！
examples.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 seoi1 jan4 sik6 saai3 ngo5 di1 syu4 pin2
